recent.text: Morez Johnson Jr. shot 1-of-10 in a 131-94 loss at TD Garden. Mavericks coach Dusty May says the rookie missed most of camp. “But success is never linear, and never happens the way we want it to,” May said. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/hJrCRpkzZp

recent.text: Zaccharie Risacher scored 18 points on 8-of-9 shooting off the bench in the Mavericks’ 131-94 loss in Boston. He credited Cooper Flagg’s leadership. “I feel lucky to be able to play with him,” Risacher said. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/lkUWvMKedl
recent.author: Grant Afseth

recent.text: Paul George drew Cooper Flagg in Boston’s 131-94 win over Dallas. Jordan Walsh says the rest of Boston’s defense shifted toward Flagg’s drives. “We just tried to shrink the floor as much as possible,” Walsh said. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/HHF6CAeWxP
recent.author: Grant Afseth

recent.text: The Celtics led the Mavericks 42-9 after one quarter and won 131-94. Cooper Flagg says Dallas did not match Boston’s compete level from the opening tip. “It’s gonna start with our vets, our leaders,” Flagg said. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/8CqIFtElFX
recent.author: Grant Afseth

recent.text: The Mavericks made 2 of 18 shots in a 42-9 first quarter and lost 131-94 in Boston. Zaccharie Risacher scored 18 points on 8-of-9 shooting, with 4 of his 8 baskets in transition. “We never played our game,” Risacher said. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/L5gpkPcaLc

recent.text: Jayson Tatum scored 32 points as the Celtics beat the Mavericks 131-94. Dallas trailed 42-9 after one quarter and fell to 7-7. “Coaches did a really good job of preparing us, and we just applied it,” Tatum said. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/ltdFuT1aCz
